Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1)  **What menu rows/options are visible?**
    There is **no menu open** in this image. The interface shows the main "WebFlix" home page with the standard sidebar navigation (Home, Shorts, Watch, Library, History, Offline, Settings, Install app).

2)  **Is this a YouTube-style settings gear menu?**
    **No**, because no menu is currently visible on the screen.

3)  **Or is it something else?**
    It is **neither**. The image displays the base layout of the application without any dropdown menus or pop-ups activated. The top-right corner shows a user profile icon ("W" Signed out), which would typically trigger an account/identity menu if clicked, but it is not currently open.
